integrity: Exact formal-power-series proof and a separate finite enumeration verifier; unperformed external audit and unresolved bibliographic priority are explicitly distinguished.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to simple cycles of length at least three; not a graph-wide gamma-positivity theorem, and not a new real-rootedness result; thesis-based priority comparison remains incomplete.
title: Explicit positive gamma enumerators for weighted-bond Möbius polynomials of cycles
